items.kind: bug (admission — residue of B401; found by reading, not reproduced)
items.title: a `for` loop whose `next` is an INHERITED DEFAULT reachable only through a DECLINED impl block still compiles: B401's post-build refusal looks only at CALLS, and a loop's `next` is not a call — predates B401
items.discussion: solver-44 (Order 44, B401 @fefe49ce); B318 (admission), B401 (admission before the fixpoint)
items.body: Reproduce first (a four-module shape with `import p1 only;` and a `for` over a type whose `Iterator::next` default lives in a declined block); then route the loop's desugared `next` through the same admission refusal as a call. Sizing S; solver, Order 45.

items.title: native — reading a FIELD on a call whose return type is INFERRED fails; B460's checked-not-hidden trait returns take the same path, so `open_channel(..).name` is refused natively
items.discussion: solver-44 (Order 44); repro `sweeps/order44/solver-44/finds/b460_native_field_read_on_inferred_return.vl`; native-44's item-3 family (a field read off a call: 78097e9f typed `Shared::read()`'s)
items.body: The Rust emitter needs the call's resolved return type at a field-read subject (the same fix shape as 78097e9f for `Shared::read()`). Pin identical on both backends. Sizing S; native, Order 45 (or native-44's parity pass).
